verdict.rationale: The pack only vaguely gestures at design tooling ("best-in-class layout tools, type tools, and more, you have full control over how you design") without any explicit mention of pen/path editing, boolean operations, or alignment tools that the story specifically asks about. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of pen tool/vector path editing, boolean union/subtract/intersect operations, and precise alignment/snapping tools, plus any hands-on corroboration of vector editing quality.
